purpose: First-attempt check of a new conversation after the drink-matching fix, without corrections, retries or further application changes.
lesson_policy: Use existing workspace settings and record actual lesson context; this is not a lesson comparison.
conversation:
HOST — Lena Torres:
Hello! I'm arranging a graduation dinner for my daughter on July 17, 2027. Could we have the Garden Patio from 5:30 PM to 8:30 PM? I initially counted 22 guests and 3 children. We'd like Menu 2 and one long table so the family can sit together.

RESTAURANT — Morgan:
The patio is available, and Menu 2 with one long table works. Please confirm the final count, your drinks, any allergies, AV needs and special requirements.

HOST — Lena Torres:
I had two people in the wrong group. The correct count is 20 guests and 5 children, still 25 people altogether. Please keep July 17 and the 5:30–8:30 PM time. For drinks, soda and juice for everybody. No alcohol, please. Everyone has responded: no allergies or dietary restrictions. No AV required and no special requirements.

RESTAURANT — Morgan:
Confirmed: July 17, 2027, 5:30 PM–8:30 PM, America/Los_Angeles time, Garden Patio, 20 guests and 5 children, 25 total. Menu 2 and one long table are confirmed. We have Nonalcoholic service, with soda and juice for everybody and no alcohol. I've recorded no allergies or dietary restrictions, no AV required and no special requirements.

HOST — Lena Torres:
Yes, those final details are right. For the guest instructions, please write: Please come through the garden gate and ask for Lena's graduation dinner.

RESTAURANT — Morgan:
Your booking is confirmed. We'll include that arrival instruction.

INTERNAL STAFF NOTE:
Morgan will check the water glasses before guests arrive.

expected.guest_notes: Please come through the garden gate and ask for Lena's graduation dinner.
expected.staff_notes: Morgan will check the water glasses before guests arrive.
expected.quote_calculation: 20 x ($58 menu + $6 drinks) + 5 x ($22 menu + $6 drinks) = $1,420
expected.drink_detail_rule: Quote, staff and guest outputs must retain both soda and juice for everyone and explicitly exclude alcohol. Equivalent wording is acceptable; a generic package label alone does not preserve the requested drinks.

checks.calendar: Correct date, final time, Pacific daylight conversion, host and patio; tentative file, never sent.
checks.quote: 20 guests plus 5 children, Menu 2, supported nonalcoholic price, $1,420; both requested drinks retained; no staff-only note.
checks.kitchen: 25 people, agreed diet and menu, 3 salad bowls/3 squash trays/3 chicken platters/25 desserts; no invented serving times.
checks.staff: Final schedule, category counts, setup, diet, AV, special confirmations, drink details and internal instruction.
checks.guest: Final event details, drink details, thankful copy and arrival instruction, with no internal staff instruction.
checks.source_support: Manually check all 18 fields and their statuses against the source; record stale values, unsupported claims or unanswered questions separately.
checks.corrections: Do not correct this event during the scored test. Keep failure or missing specificity visible in the result.

budget.note: Use one already-reserved hosted slot. Never reset or refill the allowance. No retry, even for an unknown outcome. Report token cost as an estimate, separately from reservations.

limitations: One synthetic conversation and one model attempt
